supplements.title: Optimization, characterization and biological activity of siderophore produced by marine Streptomyces coelicolor.
supplements.summary: Marine Streptomyces coelicolor-derived siderophore ferrioxamine effectively inhibited breast cancer cell (MCF-7) proliferation by disrupting iron homeostasis.

supplements.title: Emerging Biomaterials Blocking PD-1/PD-L1 Pathway for Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: New biomaterials show promise in blocking the PD-1/PD-L1 pathway, offering alternative strategies to enhance cancer immunotherapy and potentially improve patient outcomes.

supplements.title: Proanthocyanidins enhance antitumor immunity by promoting ubiquitin-proteasomal PD-L1 degradation via stabilization of LKB1 and SYVN1.
supplements.summary: Proanthocyanidins enhance cancer immunotherapy by targeting PD-L1 for degradation, activating T-cell responses and suppressing immunosuppressive cells in lung and colorectal cancers.

supplements.title: Calotropis procera flower extracts: a green approach to zinc oxide with a pineapple-like nanoleaf morphology for biological applications.
supplements.summary: Zinc oxide nanoparticles derived from Calotropis procera flower extract effectively killed A431 skin cancer cells and E. coli bacteria through reactive oxygen species generation.

supplements.title: From Signaling Pathways to Combination Therapy: Bioactive Compounds against Cancer Stem Cells.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear summary sentence:

Bioactive compounds from natural sources show promise in targeting cancer stem cells' key survival mechanisms and potentially improving treatment outcomes.

supplements.title: Green-Synthesized Silver Nanoparticles from Penicillium oxalicum with Antibreast Cancer Activities In Vitro and In Vivo.
supplements.summary: Green-synthesized silver nanoparticles from a fungal source demonstrated significant anticancer effects against breast cancer cells by inducing cell death and inhibiting tumor growth.

supplements.title: Synthesis and Acidic pH-Responsive Disassembly of Dual-Location Shell-Sheddable/Core-Degradable Block Copolymer Nanoassemblies and Their Controlled Drug Delivery.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed smart nanoparticles with two acid-sensitive locations that more efficiently release curcumin in cancer cells, improving targeted drug delivery.

supplements.title: Chiral and Dual Drugs Combination Reduces Tumor-Associated Neutrophils-Induced T-Cell Immunoparalysis to Treat Epithelial Ovarian Cancer.
supplements.summary: A combination of R-Baicalin and Astragaloside IV reduces tumor-associated neutrophils, enhancing immune response and potentially improving treatment for epithelial ovarian cancer.

supplements.title: Design, Docking, ADMET, Pass, Synthesis and Bio-Evaluation of Novel 7-O-Substituted Chrysin-Based VEGFR-2 Inhibitors.
supplements.summary: Researchers designed novel chrysin derivatives targeting breast cancer by improving VEGFR-2 inhibition, with compounds C7 and C8 showing enhanced anticancer and antioxidant properties.

supplements.title: Nutritional and Health Potential of Edible Seeds: Micronutrient Bioavailability and Mechanistic Insights.
supplements.summary: Edible seeds like pumpkin, flax, and chia contain powerful bioactive compounds that can help prevent chronic diseases and potentially support anti-cancer and cardiovascular health.

supplements.title: Orphan drug uttroside B impedes MASH progression and HCC development in experimental models.
supplements.summary: Orphan drug uttroside B shows promise in preventing liver inflammation, fat accumulation, and potential liver cancer progression in experimental models.

supplements.title: Inhalable herbal nanotherapeutics targeting lung carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Inhalable nanoparticles loaded with myricetin and targeted with lactoferrin demonstrated improved lung cancer therapy by enhancing drug delivery and tumor targeting.

supplements.title: Microbiota in cancer: current understandings and future perspectives.
supplements.summary: Microbiota play a complex role in cancer development and treatment, potentially offering both therapeutic opportunities and insights into disease progression.

supplements.title: Synergistic Anti-Inflammatory Effects and Efficient Weight Loss through the Combination of Chinese Herbs and Photothermal Therapy in Obesity Treatment.
supplements.summary: A combined photothermal therapy using a heat-generating agent and morin herb effectively reduced body weight and fat tissue in mice by 20%.

supplements.title: Green-Synthesized Gold Nanoparticles Using Ambrosia artemisiifolia: Insights into DNA Interaction, Protein Binding, Enzyme Mimicry, Anticancer Potential, and Dye Degradation Efficiency.
supplements.summary: Green-synthesized gold nanoparticles from Ambrosia artemisiifolia showed promising anticancer effects against HeLa cells with minimal toxicity to normal cells.

off_label.title: Kisspeptin improves local ovarian insulin resistance in PCOS by modulating the PI3K/AKT/GLUT4 signaling pathway.
off_label.summary: Kisspeptin treatment helped reduce insulin resistance in women with polycystic ovary syndrome by improving insulin signaling in ovarian cells.

off_label.title: Lacosamide prevents cyclophosphamide-induced testicular dysfunction via inhibition of NF-κB/IL-6/STAT-3 and JNK1/Caspase-3 axes with AR and HO-1 preservation: in vivo and in silico evidence.
off_label.summary: Lacosamide protects against chemotherapy-induced testicular damage in rats by reducing inflammation, preventing cell death, and preserving hormone and sperm function.

off_label.title: Efficacy and Safety of Apixaban in Cancer-Associated Thromboembolism: A Narrative Review.
off_label.summary: Apixaban shows promise as an effective, safer alternative to traditional blood thinners for preventing and treating blood clots in cancer patients.

off_label.title: Sex‑specific cardiovascular risk in estrogen‑treated androgen‑deprived males: metabolic characterization of glucose, adipose, and lipid pathways.
off_label.summary: Estrogen treatment in prostate cancer patients may increase cardiovascular disease risk by disrupting metabolic pathways in males.

off_label.title: Nanoparticles for Delivery of Encapsulated Drugs to Hypoxic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Cell Spheroids.
off_label.summary: Nanoparticles delivering a CXCR4 inhibitor and gemcitabine effectively reduced pancreatic cancer cell growth and survival under low-oxygen conditions.

off_label.title: Liposomal Delivery of Pyronaridine as a Repurposed Inhibitor of ERCC1/XPF for the Sensitization of Colorectal Cancer Cells to Platinum Chemotherapeutics.
off_label.summary: Liposomal pyronaridine sensitizes colorectal cancer cells to platinum chemotherapy by inhibiting DNA repair, potentially enhancing treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: Drink Responsibly: Cancer Cells Also Like Sugary Drinks.
off_label.summary: Sugar-sweetened beverages enhance colorectal cancer metastasis by boosting cell metabolism and migration through an enzyme-driven process involving glucose and fructose.

off_label.title: ESR1-Activating Mutations Confer Metabolic Vulnerabilities in ER+ Breast Cancer.
off_label.summary: ESR1 mutations in ER+ breast cancer reveal a vulnerability to ferroptosis, suggesting a potential new treatment approach with existing endocrine therapies.

off_label.title: Orphan drug uttroside B impedes MASH progression and HCC development in experimental models.
off_label.summary: Orphan drug uttroside B shows promise in preventing liver inflammation, fat accumulation, and potential liver cancer progression in experimental models.

off_label.title: Potentiating anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects in vitro: the combined action of zofenoprilat and nebivolol.
off_label.summary: Zofenoprilat and nebivolol together showed enhanced anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, potentially improving vascular health and reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: Impact of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors on heart failure outcomes in cancer patients and survivors: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors may reduce heart failure hospitalizations and new diagnoses among cancer patients, offering potential cardiovascular protection during treatment.

off_label.title: The Role of Social Ties and Social Support in Maintaining Physical and Mental Well-Being Among Korean Americans Living with Chronic Hepatitis B.
off_label.summary: For Korean Americans with Hepatitis B, stronger social connections and support are linked to better physical and mental health outcomes over time.

off_label.title: Microbiota in cancer: current understandings and future perspectives.
off_label.summary: Microbiota play a complex role in cancer development and treatment, potentially offering both therapeutic opportunities and insights into disease progression.

off_label.title: Synergistic effects of elranatamab and Juzentaihoto, Japanese traditional herbal medicine, in triple-class-exposed relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with extramedullary disease: a case report.
off_label.summary: The addition of Juzentaihoto, a Japanese herbal medicine, enhanced elranatamab's effectiveness in a multiple myeloma patient by boosting immune cell counts and improving treatment response.

off_label.title: Multi-omics unravels multiple pharmacological actions in a murine model of infantile hemangioma receiving oxymatrine therapy.
off_label.summary: Oxymatrine effectively inhibits infantile hemangioma growth by targeting multiple molecular pathways in a mouse model, offering a potential alternative treatment for drug-resistant cases.

biomarkers.title: DNA methylation triage of human papillomavirus-positive atypical squamous cells of undetermined significance in cervical cancer screening.
biomarkers.summary: A DNA methylation test could help reduce unnecessary colposcopy referrals for women with HPV and uncertain cervical cell changes.

biomarkers.title: Malassezia globosa lipidome: The dynamics of uptake and secreted lipids.
biomarkers.summary: A detailed analysis of Malassezia globosa lipid dynamics reveals complex consumption and secretion patterns of 87 lipids across different metabolic phases.

biomarkers.title: Adding anti-PD-1 antibody to definitive chemoradiotherapy in elderly patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: higher intensity does not equate to better outcomes.
biomarkers.summary: For elderly esophageal cancer patients, adding an anti-PD-1 antibody to standard chemoradiation did not improve treatment outcomes or survival.

biomarkers.title: GNE-related thrombocytopenia (Thrombocytopenia-12) in a 3-month-old from a Middle Eastern background infant: a case report.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a rare genetic mutation causing low platelet count in a young infant from a Middle Eastern family, expanding understanding of congenital thrombocytopenia.

biomarkers.title: Non-coding small RNAs buffer protein interactions to prevent oncogenic aggregation: structural dampening of aberrant PPIs by RNA.
biomarkers.summary: Non-coding RNAs can prevent cancer-causing protein aggregation by buffering protein interactions and maintaining structural stability in molecular complexes.

biomarkers.title: PTP1B inhibition promotes microglial phagocytosis in Alzheimer's disease models by enhancing SYK signaling.
biomarkers.summary: PTP1B inhibition enhances microglia's ability to clear amyloid plaques in Alzheimer's disease by boosting immune cell function and metabolism.

biomarkers.title: Childhood thiamine-responsive megaloblastic anemia and diabetes: a case series highlighting early diagnosis and management.
biomarkers.summary: Targeted high-dose thiamine therapy can quickly improve symptoms and prevent long-term complications in children with a rare genetic disorder causing anemia and early-onset diabetes.

biomarkers.title: Theranostic Folate-Targeted Doxorubicin-Loaded MIL-88A@CuFe2O4 Nanohybrids, a pH-Sensitive, Core-Shell, Mesoporous Drug Delivery Platform with Dual-Modal T1-T2MRI and Optical Imaging Contrast Properties: An In Vitro and In Vivo Cancer Study.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a novel nanoplatform that combines targeted drug delivery, dual-mode imaging, and effective therapy for triple-negative breast cancer.

biomarkers.title: Pediatric craniopharyngioma: when hypoglycemia reveals a brain tumor. Illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: A pediatric brain tumor (craniopharyngioma) was uniquely first detected through severe low blood sugar, highlighting an uncommon initial symptom of this rare condition.

biomarkers.title: Primary subdural tumor mimicking subdural hematoma: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: A rare pediatric case highlights how some subdural tumors can look like blood clots on initial medical imaging.

biomarkers.title: Challenges in diagnosing and treating lumbosacral dermoid cyst in an older patient: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

A rare lumbosacral dermoid cyst in an older patient underscores the importance of considering this diagnosis despite nonspecific symptoms.

biomarkers.title: Molecular classification of radiation-induced meningiomas.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers classified radiation-induced meningiomas using molecular techniques to better understand their unique genetic characteristics and potential clinical implications.

biomarkers.title: The role of HLA transcription in unrelated hematopoietic cell transplantation.
biomarkers.summary: In unrelated hematopoietic cell transplantation, higher HLA gene expression levels are linked to increased graft-versus-host disease risk and potentially lower relapse rates.

biomarkers.title: CPX-351 Selectively Benefits Patients with AML and Myelodysplasia-Related Mutations in the Pivotal Randomized Trial.
biomarkers.summary: In AML patients with myelodysplasia-related mutations, CPX-351 significantly improved overall survival compared to standard therapy, particularly for those undergoing transplantation.

biomarkers.title: Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation in ERCC6L2 Disease.
biomarkers.summary: Allogeneic stem cell transplantation offers a potential cure for ERCC6L2 disease, with 79% one-year survival but significant risks of endothelial complications.
